{{Quote|You will gain the Mark of Courage by defeating a ferocious beast bent on terrorizing the world. Speak with the people of the cities of Tatooine. Perhaps they know of such a beast.|A [[Unidentified Rodian hermit|Rodian hermit]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Mark of the Hero|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Bladeback boars''' were a rare and aggressive race of [[zucca boar]], an animal native to the desert planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one such bladeback boar terrorized residents of Tatooine, but was [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|vanquished]] by a [[Hero of Tatooine|heroic spacer]] who was then awarded the [[Mark of Courage]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bladeback boars appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Wild bladeback boars were added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Hero of Tatooine|"Hero of Tatooine" questline]],<ref name="SWG" /> released with "[[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]" on [[June 29]], [[2004]].<ref>{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref> In the original version of the questline, the creature spawned at random places across the planet Tatooine and players taking part in the "Courage" segment of the "Hero of Tatooine" had to find one such bast and kill it.<ref name="SWG" /> The "Hero of Tatooine" questline was extensively revamped upon the introduction of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> and wild bladeback boars were removed from the game by mistake. The questline was therefore broken and impossible to finish until bladeback boars were restored with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2.3|Chapter 2.3]]" update, released on [[August 16]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref> The new version of the quest was significantly easier since wild bladeback boars now spawned at specific locations.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />
